Proposition
[Closed geodesic representatives] 1. Proposition 5.3.1\group hyperbolic geometrySource: thurston:page-0100, thurston:page-0101 Every nontrivial free homotopy class in a closed hyperbolic manifold contains a unique closed geodesic.
Proof

\sketch A nontrivial deck transformation is neither elliptic nor parabolic: ellipticity contradicts freeness and parabolicity would give arbitrarily short closed curves in a compact manifold. It is therefore hyperbolic, translating along a unique axis; axes project to the same geodesic exactly under conjugacy.

□
